parameters.query:
SELECT g.id AS guest_id, g.party_id, g.status AS guest_status
FROM guests g
JOIN parties p ON p.id = g.party_id
WHERE g.join_token = $1
  AND g.status = 'active'
  AND p.status = 'active'
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  v.party_can_pay,
  v.subtotal_required,
  v.subtotal_claimed,
  v.tip_percent,
  COALESCE(sub.guest_subtotal, 0)        AS guest_subtotal_cents
FROM party_validation_view v
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT i.party_id,
         SUM(s.quantity * i.unit_price_cents) AS guest_subtotal
  FROM selections s
  JOIN items i ON i.id = s.item_id
  WHERE s.guest_id = $2::uuid
  GROUP BY i.party_id
) sub ON sub.party_id = v.party_id
WHERE v.party_id = $1::uuid

INSERT INTO payments (party_id, guest_id, amount_paid_cents)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, amount_paid_cents, created_at
